concepts.label: Organisation
concepts.definition: A legal entity the estate does business with, resolved from the records that describe it.

concepts.label: City
concepts.definition: The place an organisation's records give as its location.

concepts.label: Country
concepts.definition: The country a city lies in.

concepts.label: Industry
concepts.definition: The line of business the records assign to an organisation.

concepts.label: Source system
concepts.definition: A system of record that holds records about organisations.
